column1: # Interview-Prep paths are relative to interview-prep/. `@notes` = the whole note.

column4: Registration, password login, sessions, refresh-token rotation, JWKS, service-to-service tokens
TOTP MFA with recovery codes, Google OIDC login (PKCE), account linking
Shops as tenants: memberships, roles and permissions, invites, per-shop SSO, cells, offboarding
Staged onboarding questionnaire, KYC document intake, LLM extraction, human review, shop verification
Product CRUD, pricing, stock fields, product cache and invalidation, product views
Collaborative listing drafts (CRDT rooms, permissions per update, version history, publish)
Bulk catalog import: multipart upload, AV scan, streamed parse, checkpoints, error report
Shopify/WooCommerce catalog and stock sync (incremental, bidirectional stock, reconciliation, quarantine)
Offline-first inventory sync for store devices (op idempotency, deltas, per-field LWW, conflicts)
Cart (guest + merge), idempotent checkout, stock reservation, multi-shop split, order state machine, payment webhook
Flash sales: bucketed Redis stock, admission, never oversell, async reconciliation to Postgres
Order export (streamed CSV to object storage, progress) including moving its routes and queue out of catalog-sync (debt D-10)
Payment intents, idempotency, unknown outcomes, PSP circuit breaker, outbox, saga with orders
Double-entry ledger, balanced journals, hot-account sharding, balance read model, daily PSP reconciliation
Seller payouts: weekly run, reserves, provider transfer with idempotency, payout states
Bitemporal commission rates, monthly statements, period close, adjustments, as-of reports, CSV export
Plans, versioned prices, subscription state machine, billing run, proration, dunning
Usage metering (late events, adjustments) and entitlement checks used by other domains
Pickup points, local stock, "available near me" search, map clustering
Same-day courier dispatch: location ingest, offers with timeout, delivery state machine, live tracking
English auctions: proxy bids, anti-sniping, reserve, exactly-once close, second chance, shill guard
Launch-event booking: waiting room, admission tokens, seat holds, booking confirm, seat map, ticket limits
Live launch stream comments and reactions: sampling, batching, moderation, pinned commerce
Product chat: channels, idempotent send, per-channel sequence, sync on reconnect, unread, receipts, presence, offline push
Product discussion boards: posts, nested comments, votes, hot/top/new/best ranking, abuse controls, safe markdown
Follow graph and home feed (hybrid fan-out, celebrity merge, rebuild on return)
Brand stories CMS: versioned multi-locale stories, scheduled publish, preview, cache tags, sitemap
Notification routing: preferences, quiet hours, caps, per-channel queues, provider failover, inbox, suppression
Product and review photos: presigned upload, processing pipeline, EXIF strip, variants, duplicate detection
Product video and VOD: resumable upload, transcoding DAG, HLS ladder, signed delivery
Shop asset library (chunked dedupe, delta sync, conflicts, share links) and digital product delivery
Product search: index sync with external versioning, zero-downtime reindex, relevance boosts, synonyms, facets, k-NN
Search autocomplete: query-log top-K trie, catalog completions, per-source budgets, typo fallback
Bought together recommendations: co-occurrence graph, normalisation, 2-hop cold start
Trending products: windowed approximate top-K per category
Sponsored listings: signed click tokens, exact dedupe, click-spam filter, reconciled billing
Share and affiliate short links: code generation, custom aliases, redirects, click attribution
Feature flags and remote config: targeting, % rollout, local evaluation, kill switches, audit
Analytics ingestion and A/B testing: event schema, dedupe, assignment, exposure, SRM, results
Seller leaderboards (ties, my rank, period snapshots), live sales dashboard, seller stats
Competitor price monitor: polite crawling, robots, SSRF-safe fetch, price extraction, alerts
Seller public API: API keys, scopes, sandbox, date-pinned versions, deprecation headers, batch, request logs
Webhook delivery to shops: subscriptions, signing with dual secrets, per-endpoint ordering, retries, auto-disable, replay
Embeddable storefront widget: site keys bound to origins, frame-ancestors, identity hand-off, kill switch
Seller discount functions: submission, sandboxed judge with test cases, versions, fail-safe evaluation at checkout
Streamed shopping assistant: read-only tools, resumable streams, quotas, fallback model, moderation
Ask this product and shop help center: ingestion, hybrid retrieval with in-query permissions, citations
BFF composition: product-page aggregate with budgets and partial errors, GraphQL with DataLoaders and limits, session handling
Distributed job scheduler: SKIP LOCKED leases, retries, cron leader, fairness, tz-aware cron
Rate limiting: token bucket, sliding window, concurrency limits, fail modes, headers
Realtime push hub: topic SSE, Last-Event-ID replay, per-topic policies, ref-counted fan-out
Cache toolkit: L1/L2, single-flight, XFetch, SWR, negative cache, write-behind counters, ETags
Domain events, outbox/CDC → Kafka, idempotent versioned projections, replay, read-your-writes
Platform toolkit: problem+json errors, request context and transactions, health probes, graceful shutdown, load shedding, resilient HTTP
Lambda workers: partial batch failures, idempotency records, FIFO groups, local runner

column1: # Web app (packages/web, Next.js). Sources list the backend capabilities each surface calls; specs cover pages, client
# state, accessibility, responsive layout states, and the Playwright happy-path journeys (constitution VI, VII.7).

column4: Sign up, log in, forgot password, MFA step-up, session cookie via BFF, CSRF, logout, account state in the navbar
Home, search (autocomplete, filters, facets, sort, URL state), trending and recommendation rails, product page (product, shop, pickup near me, discussions, ask this product, share link)
Cart (guest and merged on login), checkout with idempotent submit and async payment status, success page, order history, notification popover
Seller dashboard: shop overview, live sales numbers, inventory management, developer settings (API keys, webhook endpoints)
Product chat (realtime, unread, receipts, reconnect) and the streamed shopping assistant sheet (resume, abort, errors)
Admin feature-flag console: list, edit targeting and rollout, kill switch, audit trail
App shell and cross-cutting UI: navbar, footer, legal pages, developer docs, error/not-found/loading states, responsive layout, accessibility, CSP and security headers

column1: # Cross-domain journeys: black-box API e2e against the running local monolith (packages/backend/test/journeys),
# proving the event-driven hand-offs between domains that per-capability specs can't (outbox → Kafka → projectors).

column4: Buyer pays for a multi-shop order; order paid → ledger journals → settlement → seller payout → monthly statement; buyer and sellers notified
New seller registers, creates a shop, passes onboarding/KYC, subscribes to a plan, lists a product that becomes searchable, sells it, receives the order webhook, and appears on the leaderboard
Launch day: waiting room and seat booking, flash-sale purchase without overselling, live stream comments, an auction closing with the winner's checkout, and the notifications each triggers
A shop imports its catalog (bulk file and Shopify), products become searchable and available near me, an offline store device sells stock, and the stock change syncs back to Shopify
A buyer follows a shop, sees its new product in the feed, discusses it, shares an affiliate link that converts, and the purchase shows up in recommendations, trending, and A/B experiment results
